name: Northern Provinces
description: A collection of farmsteads and small city-states on Terisiare during the Dark Age, later resettled by Kjeldorans.

description_citations.text: "Northern Provinces". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As temperatures kept rising, Argive's larger cities fell apart, leaving farmsteads and villages known as the Northern Provinces.
timeline.quote: the larger cities of old were unable to sustain themselves and fell apart

citation.text: "Northern Provinces", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tivadar and his Knightly Order, aided by Rasputin Dreamweaver, throw back the Goblin Invasions and end the Dark Ages.
timeline.quote: temporarily restored civilization to Terisiare by throwing back the Goblin Invasions
